select * from ( select
(IFNULL(day_plan_qty, 0) + IFNULL(night_plan_qty, 0)) as daily_total_qty, TRUNCATE(fq.DAY_FINISH_QTY, 0) as day_finish_qty, case when a.day_plan_qty=0 then null when a.day_plan_qty!=0 then (TRUNCATE(fq.DAY_FINISH_QTY, 0)/a.day_plan_qty) end as day_finish_rate, TRUNCATE(fq.NIGHT_FINISH_QTY, 0) as NIGHT_FINISH_QTY, case when a.night_plan_qty=0 then null when a.night_plan_qty!=0 then (TRUNCATE(fq.NIGHT_FINISH_QTY, 0)/a.night_plan_qty) end as night_finish_rate, b.MONTH_PLAN_QTY as month_plan, CEILING(b.MONTH_REMAIN_QTY) as month_plan_os, log.change_machine, log.change_day_plan, log.change_night_plan,
(TRUNCATE(IFNULL(fq.NIGHT_FINISH_QTY, 0), 0) + TRUNCATE(IFNULL(fq.DAY_FINISH_QTY, 0), 0)) AS total_finish_qty, CASE WHEN (TRUNCATE(IFNULL(day_plan_qty, 0), 0) + TRUNCATE(IFNULL(night_plan_qty, 0), 0)) != 0 THEN TRUNCATE((IFNULL(fq.NIGHT_FINISH_QTY, 0) + IFNULL(fq.DAY_FINISH_QTY, 0)) / (TRUNCATE(IFNULL(day_plan_qty, 0), 0) + TRUNCATE(IFNULL(night_plan_qty, 0), 0)), 4) ELSE 0 END AS daily_finish_rate from t_cd90_schedule_result a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MATERIAL_CODE,MONTH_PLAN_QTY,MONTH_REMAIN_QTY FROM T_CD90_MONTH_PLAN_SURPLUS WHERE del_flag='0' and YEAR=#{year,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and MONTH=#{month,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) b on a.CLOTH_CODE=b.MATERIAL_CODE LEFT JOIN T_CD90_DAY_FINISH_QTY fq on a.order_no = fq.order_no and fq.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN (/*调度员操作日志，判断调度员是否有做“转机台”或“调量”操作*/ SELECT schedule_id, max(IF(BEFORE_MACHINE_ID = AFTER_MACHINE_ID,0,1)) change_machine, max(IF(BEFORE_DAY_PLAN = AFTER_DAY_PLAN,0,1)) change_day_plan, max(IF(BEFORE_NIGHT_PLAN = AFTER_NIGHT_PLAN,0,1)) change_night_plan FROM T_CD90_DISPATCHER_LOG where schedule_date = #{scheduleDate} group by schedule_id ) log ON a.id = log.schedule_id where a.del_flag='0' and a.schedule_date = #{scheduleDate,jdbcType=DATE}
and INSTR(a.big_roll_code, #{bigRollCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and INSTR(a.cloth_code, #{clothCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and instr(concat(',',a.machine_id,','), concat(',',#{machineId},','))>0 and a.IS_RELEASE = #{isRelease} and a.id in #{scheduleId} order by (case when instr(machine_id,',') > 0 then machine_id when machine_id is null or machine_id = '' then '0' else '-1' end) desc/*多个机台 和 没有机台的排在前面*/, a.big_roll_code,a.cloth_code asc ) t
order by ${orderStr}

fq.NIGHT_FINISH_QTY as NIGHT_FINISH_QTY, case when a.night_plan_qty=0 then null when a.night_plan_qty!=0 then (fq.NIGHT_FINISH_QTY/a.night_plan_qty) end as night_finish_rate,

LEFT JOIN T_CD90_DAY_FINISH_QTY fq on a.schedule_date =fq.schedule_date and a.CLOTH_CODE=fq.CLOTH_CODE
where a.id = #{id} limit 1

INSERT INTO MES_CD90_SCHEDULE_RESULT( SCHEDULE_DATE , CX_BATCH_NO , BATCH_NO , ORDER_NO , BIG_ROLL_CODE , CLOTH_CODE , SAP_MATERIAL_CODE , UNIT_CONSUME , MACHINE_CODE , STOCK_QTY , SUPPLY_TIME , NIGHT_PLAN_QTY , NIGHT_PRODUCE_ORDER , NIGHT_SYS_ANALYSIS , NIGHT_HAND_ANALYSIS , DAY_PLAN_QTY , DAY_PRODUCE_ORDER , DAY_SYS_ANALYSIS , DAY_HAND_ANALYSIS , CX_CLASS1_PLAN , CX_CLASS2_PLAN , CX_CLASS3_PLAN , CX_CLASS4_PLAN , CX_CLASS5_PLAN , IS_RELEASE , MARK_CLOSE_OUT_TIP , PRODUCTION_STATUS , CRAFT, REMARK , DATA_VERSION , CREATE_DATE , UPDATE_DATE , IS_DELETE, FACTORY_CODE, COMPANY_CODE ) SELECT SCHEDULE_DATE , CX_BATCH_NO , BATCH_NO , ORDER_NO , BIG_ROLL_CODE , CLOTH_CODE , SAP_MATERIAL_CODE , UNIT_CONSUME , m.MACHINE_CODE , STOCK_QTY , SUPPLY_TIME , DAY_PLAN_QTY , DAY_PRODUCE_ORDER , DAY_SYS_ANALYSIS , DAY_HAND_ANALYSIS , NIGHT_PLAN_QTY , NIGHT_PRODUCE_ORDER , NIGHT_SYS_ANALYSIS , NIGHT_HAND_ANALYSIS , CX_CLASS1_PLAN , CX_CLASS2_PLAN , CX_CLASS3_PLAN , CX_CLASS4_PLAN , CX_CLASS5_PLAN , '1', MARK_CLOSE_OUT_TIP, PRODUCTION_STATUS, r.CRAFT, r.REMARK, #{dataVersion} DATA_VERSION, #{createTime} CREATE_DATE, r.UPDATE_TIME UPDATE_DATE, r.DEL_FLAG IS_DELETE, #{factoryCode}, #{companyCode} FROM T_CD90_SCHEDULE_RESULT r LEFT JOIN T_CD90_MACHINE_INFO m ON r.machine_id = m.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT max(SAP_MATERIAL_CODE) SAP_MATERIAL_CODE, TIRE_FABRIC_CODE FROM ( SELECT max(TIRE_FABRIC_SAP1) SAP_MATERIAL_CODE,TIRE_FABRIC_CODE1 TIRE_FABRIC_CODE FROM T_CONSTRUCTION_VERSION_INFO WHERE DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY TIRE_FABRIC_CODE1 union SELECT max(TIRE_FABRIC_SAP2) SAP_MATERIAL_CODE,TIRE_FABRIC_CODE2 TIRE_FABRIC_CODE FROM T_CONSTRUCTION_VERSION_INFO WHERE DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY TIRE_FABRIC_CODE2 union SELECT max(TIRE_FABRIC_SAP3) SAP_MATERIAL_CODE,TIRE_FABRIC_CODE3 TIRE_FABRIC_CODE FROM T_CONSTRUCTION_VERSION_INFO WHERE DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY TIRE_FABRIC_CODE3 ) t GROUP BY TIRE_FABRIC_CODE ) p ON r.CLOTH_CODE = p.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE WHERE r.id in #{id}

SELECT SUM(night_plan_qty) as night_plan_qty FROM t_cd90_schedule_result WHERE schedule_date = DATE_SUB(#{scheduleDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
and INSTR(big_roll_code, #{bigRollCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and INSTR(cloth_code, #{clothCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and instr(concat(',',machine_id,','), concat(',',#{machineId},','))>0
and IS_RELEASE = #{isRelease}

SELECT IFNULL(CEILING(sum((IFNULL(cxr.CLASS3_PLANNED_QTY, 0) + IFNULL(cxr.CLASS2_PLAN_QTY, 0)) * ci.SIDEWALL_LENGTH / 1000)),0) cxConsumeQty FROM T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT cxr /*成型排程结果表*/ inner join T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO ci on cxr.EMBRYO_CODE = ci.embryo_code and cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION = ci.EMBRYO_VERSION /*施工信息表*/ WHERE cxr.schedule_date = STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
and INSTR(ci.CORD_SPEC, #{bigRollCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and ( INSTR(ci.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE1, #{clothCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0 OR INSTR(ci.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE2, #{clothCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0 OR INSTR(ci.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE3, #{clothCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0 )

SELECT a.cloth_code, SUM(night_plan_qty) as lastMidPlanQty, SUM(IFNULL(a.night_plan_qty, 0) / IFNULL(b.curl_length, c.param_value)) as lastMidPlanQtyRollNum FROM t_cd90_schedule_result a left join t_cd90_curl_length b on a.CLOTH_CODE = b.CLOTH_CODE and b.is_delete = '0' left join t_cd90_params c on c.del_flag = '0' and c.param_code = 'CRIMP_LENGTH' WHERE a.schedule_date = DATE_SUB(#{scheduleDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
and INSTR(a.big_roll_code, #{bigRollCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and INSTR(a.cloth_code, #{clothCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and instr(concat(',',a.machine_id,','), concat(',',#{machineId},','))>0
and a.IS_RELEASE = #{isRelease} GROUP BY a.cloth_code

SELECT clothCode, SUM(cxConsumeQty) FROM ( SELECT ci.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE1 as clothCode, IFNULL(CEILING((IFNULL(cxr.CLASS3_PLANNED_QTY, 0) + IFNULL(cxr.CLASS2_PLAN_QTY, 0)) * ci.SIDEWALL_LENGTH / 1000),0) cxConsumeQty FROM T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT cxr /*成型排程结果表*/ inner join T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO ci on cxr.EMBRYO_CODE = ci.embryo_code and cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION = ci.EMBRYO_VERSION /*施工信息表*/ WHERE cxr.schedule_date = STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND ci.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE1 != ''
and INSTR(ci.CORD_SPEC, #{bigRollCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT ci.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE2 as clothCode, IFNULL(CEILING((IFNULL(cxr.CLASS3_PLANNED_QTY, 0) + IFNULL(cxr.CLASS2_PLAN_QTY, 0)) * ci.SIDEWALL_LENGTH / 1000),0) cxConsumeQty FROM T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT cxr /*成型排程结果表*/ inner join T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO ci on cxr.EMBRYO_CODE = ci.embryo_code and cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION = ci.EMBRYO_VERSION /*施工信息表*/ WHERE cxr.schedule_date = STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND ci.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE2 != ''
and INSTR(ci.CORD_SPEC, #{bigRollCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT ci.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE3 as clothCode, IFNULL(CEILING((IFNULL(cxr.CLASS3_PLANNED_QTY, 0) + IFNULL(cxr.CLASS2_PLAN_QTY, 0)) * ci.SIDEWALL_LENGTH / 1000),0) cxConsumeQty FROM T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT cxr /*成型排程结果表*/ inner join T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO ci on cxr.EMBRYO_CODE = ci.embryo_code and cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION = ci.EMBRYO_VERSION /*施工信息表*/ WHERE cxr.schedule_date = STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND ci.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE3 != ''
and INSTR(ci.CORD_SPEC, #{bigRollCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
) t GROUP BY t.clothCode
